$description: Material vocabulary. `categories` define schedule code prefixes (e.g. ST-01) and generic considerations. `references` describe materials commonly specified in Indian interiors, for concept work only: descriptions are qualitative, `displayColor` is an approximate on-screen reference (never a colour match), and every technical property — slip resistance, water absorption, sealing, availability — must come from supplier test data for the actual lot.

natural-stone.label: Natural stone
considerations: Natural variation between blocks and lots — approve from the actual lot where possible.
Porosity, slip resistance and stain behaviour depend on the stone and its finish — obtain supplier test data.
Confirm sealing requirements and compatible cleaning products with the supplier.

engineered-stone.label: Engineered stone
considerations: Confirm heat and UV resistance for the intended location.
Confirm slab size, thickness and fabrication limits with the fabricator.

ceramic-tile.label: Ceramic tile
considerations: Wall-grade tiles may not be suitable for floors — confirm the intended use with the manufacturer.

vitrified-tile.label: Vitrified / porcelain tile
considerations: Obtain the manufacturer's slip-resistance classification for floor and wet-area use.
Large formats need flatness tolerances and appropriate adhesive — confirm with the tiling contractor.

handmade-tile.label: Handmade tile
considerations: Expect variation in size, tone and surface — allow for it in layout and joint widths.
Confirm sealing, curing and maintenance requirements with the maker.

terrazzo.label: Terrazzo
considerations: In-situ terrazzo needs control joints and a skilled applicator — confirm the joint layout.

cementitious-finish.label: Cementitious finish
considerations: Hairline cracking is possible — agree acceptability with the client in advance.
Confirm sealer and slip resistance for wet areas.

solid-wood.label: Solid wood
considerations: Confirm species, origin, grading, moisture content and legality documentation with the supplier.
Allow for seasonal movement, especially during the monsoon.

veneer.label: Veneer
considerations: Approve flitch or leaf sequence where grain continuity matters.
Specify the substrate (e.g. plywood grade) separately.

laminate.label: Laminate
considerations: Confirm edge-banding colour match and the post-forming limits.

paint.label: Paint
considerations: Specify the full system: primer, putty and finish coats.
Use moisture-tolerant systems in bathrooms and kitchens — confirm with the manufacturer.

plaster.label: Plaster
considerations: Lime finishes need skilled applicators and curing time — confirm the programme.

metal.label: Metal
considerations: Confirm the grade and coating for humid or coastal locations.

glass.label: Glass
considerations: Use safety glass where human impact is possible — confirm the specification with the supplier.

fabric.label: Fabric
considerations: Confirm abrasion rating, light fastness and cleaning method for the intended use.

wallpaper.label: Wallpaper
considerations: Not recommended on walls with damp risk — check the substrate moisture first.

references.label: Kota stone
references.description: Fine-grained limestone, typically blue-green to grey or brown, widely used for floors in India.

references.label: Kadappa (Cuddapah) stone
references.description: Dense, dark grey-black limestone used for floors, counters and shelving.

references.label: Jaisalmer yellow limestone
references.description: Warm yellow to golden limestone, often with fossil inclusions.

references.label: Makrana marble
references.description: White marble with soft grey veining.

references.label: Tandur stone
references.description: Limestone available in yellow and blue-grey variants, used for floors and paving.

references.label: Athangudi tile
references.description: Handmade cement tile with patterns laid into the surface; each tile varies slightly.

references.label: Red oxide flooring
references.description: In-situ cement floor finish coloured with red oxide pigment and polished by hand.

references.label: In-situ terrazzo
references.description: Cement or resin matrix with stone chips, ground and finished on site.

references.label: Teak
references.origin: Confirm source and legality documentation with the supplier
references.description: Tectona grandis. Warm golden-brown timber used for doors, frames and furniture.

references.label: Sheesham
references.origin: Confirm source and legality documentation with the supplier
references.description: Dalbergia sissoo (Indian rosewood). Dense timber with pronounced grain, common in furniture.

references.label: Lime plaster (araish)
references.description: Lime-based plaster that can be burnished to a soft sheen.
